The Story

It started with a simple frustration.

Picture a Saturday in Henderson. Dad needs a cut, so he drives to one shop. Mom needs hers done, so she drives to another. The kids need theirs, and that is a third stop across town. Half the day is gone, and nobody even left the car happy.

That is exactly why Michael's is a barber shop and a style shop under one roof. One address, one trip, and every head in the family gets taken care of by people who cut with care and pay attention to the details.

One Trip

No more running all over Henderson. The whole family gets cut on the same visit.

One Roof

Barbering and full service styling, side by side, at 1366 N Garnett Street.

Every Head

Men, women, and children, all welcome, all in a shop that feels like home.

The Walk Out Sharp Guarantee

If you don't walk out sharper than you walked in, your next cut is on the house.

That is the deal, plain and simple. You should never have to pay twice to leave a shop looking right, so if a cut from Michael's doesn't have you walking out sharp, the fix is on us.
